title: cystopus crispus
intro: Cystopus crispus, commonly known as sea squirt, is a type of marine algae that belongs to the class Ascothoracica. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cystopus crispus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and show anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include polysaccharides, sulfated polysaccharides, and other bioactive compounds that have been identified in various studies.
